rows.q: How volatile was NVIDIA stock during fiscal 2023?
rows.answer:
NVIDIA's fiscal 2023 (ended 2023-01-29) was highly volatile: measured over 250 trading days, average 20-day annualized volatility was **62.8%**, with a peak of **86.7%**, and the stock fell as much as **-66.3%** from its running high [NVDA-2023-FY].

Quarter-by-quarter (20-day annualized vol, average / peak, and worst drawdown):

| Period | Period end | Avg vol | Peak vol | Worst drawdown |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FY2023 Q1 | 2022-05-01 | 66.2% | 77.4% | -44.8% [NVDA-2023-Q1] |
| FY2023 Q2 | 2022-07-31 | 68.5% | 86.7% | -56.5% [NVDA-2023-Q2] |
| FY2023 Q3 | 2022-10-30 | 56.7% | 64.9% | -66.3% [NVDA-2023-Q3] |

So volatility peaked in Q2 (Aug 2022, ~87% annualized) and the drawdown deepened through the year to a -66% trough.
